coverageStatus.zh: 文字覆盖较完整；图像不可用；二级市场与馆藏为缺口
coverageStatus.en: Text coverage substantial; images unavailable; secondary market and collections are gaps

coverageDetail.zh: 本报告基于2026年10月31日实际访问的公开网页：博览会主办方页面、UCCA、亚洲文化协会、圣达菲SITE、里昂双年展等机构页面，以及东画廊的艺术家页、新闻与出版物页面。许多展览与日期来自代理画廊新闻稿，已尽量用机构或第三方页面交叉核对；大馆当代美术馆与余德耀美术馆的官网页面在访问时未能加载，相关信息仅来自画廊转载。未使用任何拍卖行登录会话。
coverageDetail.en: Built from public pages actually fetched on 31 October 2026: fair-organizer pages, institutional pages (UCCA, Asian Cultural Council, SITE SANTA FE, Biennale de Lyon), and Don Gallery's artist, news and publication pages. Many exhibitions and dates come from the representing gallery's news posts and were cross-checked against institutional or third-party pages where possible; the Tai Kwun Contemporary and Yuz Museum websites did not load during research, so those items rest on gallery reproductions. No authenticated auction-house session was used.

summary.zh: 本报告不嵌入任何图像。所核查的图像（东画廊、UCCA、台北市立美术馆、圣达菲SITE等提供的展览现场与作品图）均有明确出处与摄影署名，但页面未载明允许第三方再发布的条款；而本报告的HTML会作为自包含文件提交到代码仓库，构成再分发。按技能规则，改为在下列缺口说明中提供原始页面链接。
summary.en: No images are embedded. The images reviewed (installation and work views supplied by Don Gallery, UCCA, Taipei Fine Arts Museum, SITE SANTA FE and others) have clear provenance and photo credits, but none of the pages states terms permitting third-party redistribution, and this self-contained HTML is committed to a repository, which is redistribution. Following the skill's rules, the gaps below link out to the original pages instead.

gaps.zh: 艺术家肖像：亚洲文化协会/ArtAsiaPacific页面有肖像（“Courtesy the Asian Cultural Council, Hong Kong”），但无再发布授权。见 https://www.artasiapacific.com/news/asian-cultural-council-names-2025-fellows/
gaps.en: Artist portrait: a portrait appears on the ACC/ArtAsiaPacific page ("Courtesy the Asian Cultural Council, Hong Kong") without redistribution terms. See https://www.artasiapacific.com/news/asian-cultural-council-names-2025-fellows/

gaps.zh: 实践语境与展览现场：UCCA“低声细语”现场图（摄影：孙诗，UCCA提供）仅供在原页面查看。见 https://www.ucca.org.cn/en/exhibition/zhang-ruyi/
gaps.en: Practice context and exhibition views: UCCA 'Speaking Softly' installation views (photo Sun Shi, courtesy UCCA) are viewable on the source page only. See https://www.ucca.org.cn/en/exhibition/zhang-ruyi/

gaps.zh: 代表作品图：作品图见东画廊艺术家页与台北双年展新闻页（台北市立美术馆提供，摄影吕国玮），未获再发布授权。见 https://www.dongallery.net/artists/49-zhang-ruyi/ 及 https://www.dongallery.net/news/103-news-zhang-ruyis-participation-in-the-14th-taipei/
gaps.en: Representative-work images: see Don Gallery's artist page and Taipei Biennial news page (courtesy Taipei Fine Arts Museum, photo Lu Guo-Way); no redistribution permission. See https://www.dongallery.net/artists/49-zhang-ruyi/ and https://www.dongallery.net/news/103-news-zhang-ruyis-participation-in-the-14th-taipei/

gaps.zh: 市场拍品图：未找到可核实的公开拍卖拍品，因此该类别不适用。
gaps.en: Market lot images: no verifiable public auction lots were found, so this category does not apply.

nationality.zh: 中国（亚洲文化协会2025年名单列为中国内地艺术家）
nationality.en: China (listed in the ACC 2025 Mainland China cohort)

disciplines.zh: 装置、雕塑、场域特定作品、综合媒介平面作品、影像
disciplines.en: Installation, sculpture, site-specific work, mixed-media two-dimensional work, video

lead.zh: 张如怡用混凝土、瓷砖、建筑碎石与仙人掌，把上海城市更新中的建材与废料转化为关于个体处境的雕塑与空间装置。
lead.en: Zhang Ruyi turns the building materials and debris of Shanghai's urban renewal — concrete, tiles, rubble, cacti — into sculptures and spatial installations about individual circumstance.

emphasis.zh: 2022–2026年间，她的机构展出从UCCA个展延伸到里昂、圣达菲、台北三个国际双年展/国际展，以及大馆和余德耀美术馆的展览，并获2025年亚洲文化协会纽约奖助金。
emphasis.en: Between 2022 and 2026 her institutional record extended from a UCCA solo show to three international biennials/survey exhibitions (Lyon, Santa Fe, Taipei) plus shows at Tai Kwun and Yuz Museum, alongside a 2025 Asian Cultural Council New York Fellowship.

body.zh: 她1985年生于上海，在上海大学美术学院先后学习版画与综合材料，自2012年起与东画廊合作，2026年11月将在东画廊西岸艺博会展位1D01展出。公开记录中的机构展览与奖助金信号清楚；缺口同样明显：未找到机构自有的馆藏记录页面，也未找到可核实的公开拍卖记录，相当一部分评论文本经由画廊发布。
body.en: Born in Shanghai in 1985, she studied printmaking and then integrated materials at Shanghai University's fine arts school and has shown with Don Gallery since 2012; in November 2026 her work appears on Don Gallery's West Bund booth 1D01. The public record shows clear institutional and fellowship signals. The gaps are just as clear: no institution-owned collection record was found, no verifiable public auction record was found, and much of the critical writing is published through the gallery.

identityFacts.zh: 1985年生于上海，现工作生活于上海（UCCA、东画廊、SITE SANTA FE）。
identityFacts.en: Born 1985 in Shanghai; lives and works in Shanghai (UCCA, Don Gallery, SITE SANTA FE).

identityFacts.zh: 2007年本科毕业于上海大学美术学院版画系，2012年硕士毕业于该院综合材料系（东画廊转载的中文简介）；余德耀美术馆展览文本称其2007年毕业于“上海美术学院版画系”，二者应指同一院校的不同称谓。
identityFacts.en: BA in printmaking (2007) and MA in integrated materials (2012), Shanghai University School of Fine Arts (Chinese biography reproduced by Don Gallery); Yuz Museum's text names the 'Shanghai Academy of Fine Arts' printmaking department (2007), apparently a different name for the same school.

identityFacts.zh: 合作画廊：东画廊（上海），2012年起参加该画廊群展，2014年起举办个展；香港刺点画廊（Blindspot Gallery）网站亦列其为艺术家。
identityFacts.en: Galleries: Don Gallery, Shanghai (group shows from 2012, solo shows from 2014); Blindspot Gallery, Hong Kong, also lists her as an artist.

identityFacts.zh: 主要媒介：混凝土、瓷砖、钢筋、建筑碎石、仙人掌（及其刺）、塑料薄膜、鱼缸等日常与工业材料。
identityFacts.en: Main materials: concrete, ceramic tiles, rebar, construction debris, cacti and cactus spines, plastic film, aquariums and other everyday and industrial materials.

identityFacts.zh: 首部专著《ZHANG Ruyi》2024年由Skira出版（ISBN 978-88-572-4889-9），Manuela Lietti编，Karen Smith、吴墨、邱韵撰文。
identityFacts.en: First monograph, ZHANG Ruyi, published by Skira in 2024 (ISBN 978-88-572-4889-9), edited by Manuela Lietti, with essays by Karen Smith, Wu Mo and Qiu Yun.

identityFacts.zh: 与艺术家刘任为伴侣；二人2007年同时从版画系毕业，2026年在余德耀美术馆举办双人展。
identityFacts.en: Partner of artist Liu Ren; both graduated from the printmaking department in 2007 and held a duo exhibition at Yuz Museum in 2026.

description.zh: UCCA与东画廊资料均载其1985年生于上海。
description.en: UCCA and Don Gallery both record her birth in Shanghai in 1985.

title.zh: 版画专业时期的格纸绘画
title.en: Graph-paper drawings as a printmaking student

description.zh: 据邱韵文章，2005年她在上海大学美术学院版画专业二年级时，在标准格纸上绘制女性形象并做成经折装艺术家书。
description.en: According to Qiu Yun, in 2005, as a second-year printmaking student at Shanghai University's fine arts school, she drew female figures on standard graph paper and bound them as an accordion-fold artist's book.

title.zh: 本科毕业；与刘任结为伴侣

description.zh: 2007年版画系本科毕业；余德耀美术馆文本称她与刘任毕业后成为生活伴侣。UCCA称她毕业后不久在租住的破旧公寓中发现前租客留下的仙人掌，由此开始关注这一植物。
description.en: Graduated in printmaking in 2007; Yuz Museum's text says she and Liu Ren became life partners after graduating. UCCA says that shortly after graduation she found a cactus left by a previous tenant in a run-down rented flat, which started her interest in the plant.

description.zh: 2012年硕士毕业于上海大学美术学院综合材料系。
description.en: Completed an MA in integrated materials at Shanghai University School of Fine Arts in 2012.

description.zh: 研究生期间在上海虹口一处老房子里用混凝土封住门窗与通道（ARTnews中文版访谈）；东画廊将此列为其2011年的项目。
description.en: As a graduate student she sealed the doors, windows and passages of an old house in Hongkou, Shanghai, with concrete (ARTnews China interview); Don Gallery dates the project to 2011.

title.zh: 东画廊首次个展“隔 | 断”

description.en: 12 September – 26 October 2014.

description.zh: 2016年11月3日—12月25日东画廊第二次个展；同年参加西岸艺博会ArtReview Asia Xiàn Chǎng单元（王懿泉采访）。
description.en: Second Don Gallery solo, 3 November – 25 December 2016; the same year she took part in West Bund's ArtReview Asia Xiàn Chǎng section (Wang Yiquan interview).

title.zh: 艺术8中国青年艺术家奖；格兰菲迪驻留

description.zh: 获2017年“艺术8”中国奖（Prix Yishu 8 Chine，提名人为上海当代艺术馆策展人王维卫）；参加苏格兰达夫镇格兰菲迪驻留项目；参展UCCA“新常态：艺术与2017”。
description.en: Won Prix Yishu 8 Chine 2017 (nominated by MoCA Shanghai curator Wang Weiwei); joined the Glenfiddich Artists in Residence programme in Dufftown, Scotland; showed in UCCA's 'The New Normal: China, Art and 2017'.

title.zh: 巴塞尔香港“艺术探新”项目

description.zh: 2018年3月27—31日在巴塞尔艺术展香港展会“艺术探新”单元呈现个人项目“侧面”；同年参展上海外滩美术馆、香港K11艺术基金会。
description.en: Solo project 'Profile' in the Discoveries sector of Art Basel Hong Kong, 27–31 March 2018; also shown that year at Rockbund Art Museum and K11 Art Foundation, Hong Kong.

description.zh: 在洛杉矶François Ghebaly画廊举办首个美国个展；11月在东画廊举办“以为何处”。
description.en: First US solo exhibition at François Ghebaly, Los Angeles; 'Consciousness of Location' at Don Gallery opened in November.

description.zh: 参展第16届里昂双年展“脆弱宣言”（9月14日—12月31日）；12月23日UCCA北京开幕其迄今规模最大的机构个展“低声细语”。
description.en: Took part in the 16th Lyon Biennale, 'Manifesto of Fragility' (14 September – 31 December); her largest institutional solo to date, 'Speaking Softly', opened at UCCA Beijing on 23 December.

title.zh: 外滩美术馆项目、斯普鲁斯·马格斯群展、Skira专著
title.en: Rockbund project, Sprüth Magers group show, Skira monograph

description.zh: 作为特邀合作艺术家参与上海外滩美术馆“覆写上海”（3月23日—8月25日）；参加柏林Sprüth Magers群展“territory”（4月26日—6月29日）；Skira出版专著。
description.en: Featured collaborator in Rockbund Art Museum's 'Shanghai Palimpsest' (23 March – 25 August); group show 'territory' at Sprüth Magers, Berlin (26 April – 29 June); Skira monograph published.

title.zh: 亚洲文化协会奖助金；圣达菲与台北
title.en: ACC fellowship; Santa Fe and Taipei

description.zh: 5月获亚洲文化协会2025年纽约奖助金；参展第12届SITE SANTA FE国际展“曾几何时”（6月27日—2026年1月12日）与第14届台北双年展“地平线上的低吟”（11月1日—2026年3月29日）。
description.en: Awarded an Asian Cultural Council 2025 New York Fellowship in May; showed in the 12th SITE SANTA FE International, 'Once Within a Time' (27 June 2025 – 12 January 2026), and the 14th Taipei Biennial, 'Whispers on the Horizon' (1 November 2025 – 29 March 2026).

title.zh: 大馆、余德耀；纽约研究期
title.en: Tai Kwun, Yuz; New York research period

description.zh: 参展大馆当代美术馆“保持在线：全球供应”（2月27日—5月31日）；与刘任在余德耀美术馆举办双人展（3月22日—6月21日）；按东画廊发布，亚洲文化协会资助其于2026年7—12月赴美研究。
description.en: Showed in Tai Kwun Contemporary's 'Stay Connected: Supplying the Globe' (27 February – 31 May); duo exhibition with Liu Ren at Yuz Museum (22 March – 21 June); per Don Gallery, the ACC funds her US research from July to December 2026.

interactionLead.zh: 在上海出生、求学和工作，使城市更新成为她作品的直接素材。
interactionLead.en: Being born, trained and based in Shanghai has made urban renewal the direct material of her work.

interactionBody.zh: 公开资料显示，她的若干核心母题都可追溯到具体的生活经历：版画训练带来的网格与重复（UCCA），毕业后租住毛坯房时遇到的仙人掌（UCCA），以及她在访谈中提到的“住的地方完全毛坯……就好似水泥包裹着我”（ARTnews中文版）。她收集的建筑碎石多来自工作室附近的拆迁现场（François Ghebaly展览文本）。这些说法均出自已注明的来源；“生活经验塑造了材料选择”是本报告的综合判断。
interactionBody.en: Public sources trace several core motifs to specific experiences: grids and repetition from printmaking training (UCCA), the cactus found in an unfinished rented flat after graduation (UCCA), and, in her own words, living in a bare-concrete flat felt 'as if cement wrapped around me' (ARTnews China). Her construction rubble is often collected from demolition sites near her studio (François Ghebaly exhibition text). Each of these statements comes from a named source; the claim that lived experience shaped her material choices is this report's synthesis.

axisLeft.zh: 城市建材与工业秩序（混凝土、瓷砖、网格、钢筋）
axisLeft.en: Urban building materials and industrial order (concrete, tiles, grids, rebar)

axisRight.zh: 个体感知与有机生命（仙人掌、刺、鱼、水汽）
axisRight.en: Individual perception and organic life (cacti, spines, fish, vapour)

summary.zh: 她的作品处于建设与破坏之间：把日常建材从功能中剥离，与仙人掌等有机物翻模、嫁接或并置，以场域特定的方式改造展厅，讨论城市空间对个体情绪的塑造。近年作品更多使用透明薄膜、砂纸等标准化材料，并把拆迁碎料作为“城市记忆”的载体。
summary.en: Her work sits between construction and destruction: everyday building materials are stripped of function and cast with, grafted onto or set beside organic forms such as cacti, often reshaping the gallery site itself, to examine how urban space shapes individual emotion. Recent work makes more use of standardized materials such as transparent film and sandpaper, and treats demolition debris as a carrier of urban memory.

detail.zh: 以混凝土翻制仙人掌，有时以螺纹钢支撑或贯穿，使有机形态转为工业材料（UCCA；ARTnews中文版访谈）。
detail.en: Cacti are cast in concrete, sometimes propped up or pierced by rebar, turning organic form into industrial material (UCCA; ARTnews China interview).

detail.zh: 用混凝土封住门窗通道、以瓷砖墙重新分隔展厅，改变身体在空间中的状态（《我所不能了解的事》、“隔 | 断”、“对面的楼与对面的楼”）。
detail.en: Sealing doors and passages with concrete and re-dividing galleries with tiled walls to change how the body occupies space ('Things That I Don't Understand', 'Cut | Off', 'Building Opposite Building').

detail.zh: 从工作室附近拆迁现场收集碎石，嵌入仙人掌刺、指甲油等，形成《种植》系列（François Ghebaly文本；ARTnews中文版访谈）。
detail.en: Rubble collected from demolition sites near the studio is embedded with cactus spines, nail polish and similar materials, as in the 'Planter' series (François Ghebaly text; ARTnews China interview).

detail.zh: 以铝箔、UV打印、砂纸、尼龙网、胶带等装修耗材层叠成平面作品，延续版画训练中的网格（UCCA；台北双年展作品信息）。
detail.en: Two-dimensional works layered from renovation consumables such as aluminium foil, UV print, sandpaper, nylon mesh and tape, continuing the grid from her printmaking training (UCCA; Taipei Biennial work data).

detail.zh: 把混凝土雕塑浸入养有清道夫的鱼缸，或以蒸汽装置让水汽在塑料薄膜上凝结（《浸泡景观》《幽暗的灯箱》《水渍》）。
detail.en: Concrete sculptures are submerged in aquariums with suckermouth catfish, or a steam generator makes vapour condense on plastic film ('Submerged Landscape', 'Dim Light Box', 'Water Stain').

quote.zh: “‘装修’是我2017年全年艺术实践的主要方向……这一概念更涉及破坏与重建之间的双重关系，社会的种种终端都包含在这一过程中。这种关系为个体与现实的直接相遇提供了一个‘场所’。”（英文原文，本报告中译）
quote.en: "'Decoration' is the primary orientation for my artistic practice throughout the whole year of 2017. … the notion rather involves the duality of the relationship between destruction and reconstruction, in the process of which the very ends of the society are included. Such a relationship provides a location for a direct encounter between the individual and the reality."

context.zh: 艺术家为“装修：场所”（UCCA“新常态：艺术与2017”）所写的创作陈述，东画廊2017年发布。
context.en: Artist's statement for 'Decoration: Location' (UCCA, 'The New Normal: China, Art and 2017'), published by Don Gallery in 2017.

source.label: Don Gallery – Review on 'Decoration: Location' by ZHANG Ruyi

institutionalViews.institution: UCCA Center for Contemporary Art（策展人：张南 Neil Zhang）

interpretation.zh: UCCA称“低声细语”是其迄今规模最大的机构个展，系统梳理她如何以仙人掌、混凝土、网格为符号，探讨人与社会、人与建筑、自然与工业的关系，并首次集中呈现她对玻璃、塑料薄膜等透明材料的使用。
interpretation.en: UCCA describes 'Speaking Softly' as her largest institutional solo to date, a systematic overview of how she uses cacti, concrete and grids as symbols for relations between people and society, people and architecture, and the natural and industrial worlds, and the first focused presentation of her transparent materials such as glass and plastic film.

institutionalViews.institution: Biennale de Lyon（第16届，策展：Sam Bardaouil、Till Fellrath）

interpretation.zh: 里昂双年展称其装置《空地》贯穿废弃的吉美博物馆展厅，源自上海隔离与封控期间的经历，以空调外机、厨房铝材与卫浴瓷砖“连根拔起”熟悉的现实。
interpretation.en: The Biennale says her installation Vacant Lot, running through the rooms of the abandoned Musée Guimet, draws on her experience of isolation and lockdown in Shanghai, using an outdoor air-conditioning unit, kitchen aluminium and bathroom tiles to uproot familiar realities.

institutionalViews.institution: Yuz Museum 余德耀美术馆（经东画廊转载）

interpretation.zh: 余德耀美术馆文本认为她以仙人掌、混凝土、瓷砖等日常材料揭示城市生活中秩序与无序并存的隐形结构；网格、阻隔、封堵等母题暗示城市被压缩、固化的空间。
interpretation.en: Yuz Museum's text says she uses cacti, concrete, tiles and other everyday materials to reveal the invisible structures of urban life where order and disorder coexist; grids, barriers and blockages evoke the compressed, solidified spaces of the city.

source.label: Don Gallery – Yuz Museum duo exhibition

institutionalViews.institution: Rockbund Art Museum 上海外滩美术馆（经东画廊转载）

interpretation.zh: 外滩美术馆称她将三楼展厅重构为“动态文献库”，其作品是“充盈着潜藏于过往岁月和生活故事的活档案”。
interpretation.en: Rockbund says she reconceived its third-floor galleries as a 'dynamic archive', her works being 'living archives' of past years and life stories.

source.label: Don Gallery – Shanghai Palimpsest at Rockbund

synthesis.zh: 【系统综合】从上述来源看，她的实践有两条稳定线索：一是以建材与网格代表的城市秩序，二是以仙人掌为代表、在恶劣条件中存活的个体。2011年以来的作品不断调整这两者的比例：早期以封堵空间为主，2017年后转向“装修”与碎料，2022年后加入透明材料、水汽与砂纸。这一概括由本报告根据所引来源归纳，并非任何机构或艺术家的原话。
synthesis.en: [System synthesis] Across the cited sources her practice holds two steady threads: urban order, represented by building materials and grids, and the individual, represented by the cactus that survives harsh conditions. Since 2011 the balance between them has shifted: early work centred on blocking space, after 2017 it moved to 'decoration' and debris, and after 2022 it added transparent materials, vapour and sandpaper. This summary is drawn by this report from the cited sources; it is not a statement by any institution or by the artist.

medium.zh: 混凝土，封堵上海虹口一处住宅的门窗与通道（场域特定）
medium.en: Concrete sealing the doors, windows and passages of a residence in Hongkou, Shanghai (site-specific)

note.zh: 她首次以混凝土介入空间的项目（ARTnews中文版访谈；东画廊“隔 | 断”文本）。
note.en: Her first use of concrete to intervene in space (ARTnews China interview; Don Gallery 'Cut | Off' text).

note.en: Domestic fittings such as a door and floor drain rendered in concrete, an example of her space-blocking method (Don Gallery work data).

description.zh: 在格纸上绘制女性形象与植物，以木刻转印制作灯罩装置《微弱的希望》（2006–2007）；网格与重复成为此后作品的底层结构（邱韵；UCCA）。
description.en: Drawings of figures and plants on graph paper; woodblock-printed lampshade installation A Faint Hope (2006–2007). Grid and repetition became the underlying structure of later work (Qiu Yun; UCCA).

description.zh: 从《我所不能了解的事》（2011）到“隔 | 断”（2014）与“对面的楼与对面的楼”（2016），以混凝土和瓷砖墙阻隔门窗、重构展厅（东画廊；王懿泉采访）。
description.en: From Things That I Don't Understand (2011) to 'Cut | Off' (2014) and 'Building Opposite Building' (2016), concrete and tiled walls block openings and restructure the gallery (Don Gallery; Wang Yiquan interview).

description.zh: 2017年以“装修”为全年方向（UCCA“装修：场所”）；鱼缸与清道夫的《浸泡景观》（2019）、《幽暗的灯箱》（UCCA沙丘，2020）。
description.en: 2017 organised around 'Decoration' (UCCA, 'Decoration: Location'); aquarium works with catfish such as Submerged Landscape (2019) and Dim Light Box (UCCA Dune, 2020).

description.zh: “现代化石”（星美术馆，2022）、里昂双年展《空地》（2022）、UCCA“低声细语”中的塑料薄膜温室与《水渍》，以及“或废或更”（2023）中的拆迁碎料。
description.en: 'Modern Fossil' (SSSSTART, 2022), Vacant Lot at the Lyon Biennale (2022), the plastic-film greenhouse and Water Stain in UCCA's 'Speaking Softly', and the demolition debris of 'Once Remain, Once Remould' (2023).

description.zh: 外滩美术馆“覆写上海”中把展厅改作“动态文献库”（2024）；以砂纸为主的“抛光”系列（2025）；为大馆改编《倚靠》（2026）。
description.en: Reconceiving Rockbund's galleries as a 'dynamic archive' in 'Shanghai Palimpsest' (2024); the sandpaper-based 'Polish' series (2025); Leaning adapted for Tai Kwun (2026).

intro.zh: 本次检索未找到任何机构自有的馆藏记录页面。东画廊与刺点画廊的资料提到四方当代美术馆、复星艺术基金会、英国卡斯雕塑基金会的收藏，2018年复星基金会收藏展亦展出其作品，但这些都属画廊或展览层面的说法，不能代替馆藏记录，因此下方馆藏列表为空。参加机构展览也不等于被机构收藏。
intro.en: No institution-owned collection record page was found. Don Gallery and Blindspot materials mention holdings at Sifang Art Museum, Fosun Foundation and Cass Sculpture Foundation (UK), and a 2018 Fosun Foundation collection exhibition included her works, but these are gallery- or exhibition-level claims rather than collection records, so the collection list below is left empty. Taking part in museum exhibitions is not the same as being in a collection.

quote.zh: “对我来说，水泥无处不在，它也许一直在潜移默化地给我养分，所以我开始思考能不能把这种常见但又不被肉眼轻易见到的廉价材料更明白地还给空间？”
quote.en: "For me, cement is everywhere; perhaps it has been quietly nourishing me all along. So I began to wonder whether I could return this common, cheap material, which the eye seldom really sees, to space more clearly." (Chinese original; English translation by this report)

source.label: ARTnews 中文版 interview (17 Jan 2024), via Don Gallery

comparisonTitle.en: Why there are no lot cards

comparisonBody.zh: 截至2026年10月31日，对英文与中文名称结合苏富比、佳士得、富艺斯、嘉德、保利的公开检索均未找到属于这位艺术家的拍品；检索结果中出现的是同音或近名的其他人物（如明代书法家张瑞图）。本报告未使用任何拍卖行或MutualArt的登录会话，因此“未找到”只针对公开页面。画廊作品页未公开价格，本报告不推测任何价格。
comparisonBody.en: As of 31 October 2026, public searches combining her English and Chinese names with Sotheby's, Christie's, Phillips, China Guardian and Poly found no lots by this artist; results showed other people with similar names (for example the Ming calligrapher Zhang Ruitu). No authenticated auction-house or MutualArt session was used, so 'not found' covers public pages only. Gallery work pages do not publish prices, and this report does not estimate any.

aggregateReason.zh: 没有可核实的拍品样本，任何成交率、均价或趋势都无从计算。
aggregateReason.en: There is no verifiable lot sample, so no sell-through, average or trend can be calculated.

summary.zh: 公开记录显示一条清晰的机构上升线：2022年UCCA个展与里昂双年展之后，2025—2026年相继进入SITE SANTA FE国际展、台北双年展、大馆和余德耀美术馆的展览，并获亚洲文化协会纽约奖助金与Skira专著。反向信号同样需要看到：没有核实到机构馆藏记录和公开拍卖记录，部分日期与评论文本仅来自代理画廊，最近一次评审类奖项为2017年。以上为证据摘要，不构成任何预测。
summary.en: The public record shows a clear institutional trajectory: after a UCCA solo and the Lyon Biennale in 2022, she showed in 2025–2026 at the SITE SANTA FE International, the Taipei Biennial, Tai Kwun and Yuz Museum, and received an Asian Cultural Council New York Fellowship and a Skira monograph. The counter-signals matter too: no institutional collection record or public auction record was verified, some dates and critical texts come only from the representing gallery, and the most recent juried prize found dates from 2017. This is an evidence summary, not a forecast.

title.en: Some institutional data rests on gallery reproductions

detail.zh: 大馆、余德耀美术馆、外滩美术馆的展讯与日期来自东画廊页面；大馆与余德耀官网在研究时未能加载。
detail.en: Exhibition texts and dates for Tai Kwun, Yuz Museum and Rockbund come from Don Gallery pages; the Tai Kwun and Yuz websites did not load during research.

gaps.zh: 二级市场：未访问苏富比、佳士得、富艺斯或MutualArt的登录会话，亦未直接检索嘉德、保利数据库。
gaps.en: Secondary market: no authenticated Sotheby's, Christie's, Phillips or MutualArt session was used, and China Guardian and Poly databases were not searched directly.

gaps.zh: 馆藏：未逐一查询M+、龙美术馆、上海当代艺术博物馆等机构的在线馆藏数据库。
gaps.en: Collections: online collection databases of M+, Long Museum, Power Station of Art and others were not searched one by one.

gaps.zh: 一级市场：画廊未公开价格，本报告不涉及价格。
gaps.en: Primary market: the galleries do not publish prices, and this report does not address them.

gaps.zh: 西岸2026展位将展出哪些具体作品尚未公布。
gaps.en: Which specific works will be on the West Bund 2026 booth has not been published.

detail.zh: 东画廊转载的中文简介写“上海大学美术学院版画系（2007）、综合材料系硕士（2012）”；余德耀美术馆文本写“上海美术学院版画系”。上海大学美术学院现亦称上海美术学院，本报告按前者表述并注明。
detail.en: The Chinese biography reproduced by Don Gallery gives 'Shanghai University School of Fine Arts, printmaking (2007), MA integrated materials (2012)'; Yuz Museum's text says 'Shanghai Academy of Fine Arts'. The Shanghai University fine arts school is also known as the Shanghai Academy of Fine Arts; this report uses the former wording and notes the difference.

title.zh: 亚洲文化协会奖助金名称

detail.zh: ACC数据库、ArtAsiaPacific、Hyperallergic与东画廊均称其为“纽约奖助金”（New York Fellowship）；检索摘要中出现ACC香港通讯将其列于另一名目，但本报告未能打开该PDF核实，故采用前者。
detail.en: The ACC database, ArtAsiaPacific, Hyperallergic and Don Gallery all call it a New York Fellowship. A search snippet suggested an ACC Hong Kong newsletter lists it under a different name, but that PDF was not opened and verified, so the former is used.

detail.zh: 所有候选图像都缺少可再发布授权，本报告不嵌入图像，改为链接原页面，详见 image-audit.md。
detail.en: Every candidate image lacks redistribution permission, so none is embedded; the report links to the original pages instead. See image-audit.md.

detail.zh: 东画廊2026年7月9日公告她与刘任参加油罐艺术中心“建筑的铭文”，未给出展期，故未列入当前/即将展览。
detail.en: Don Gallery announced on 9 July 2026 that she and Liu Ren are in TANK Shanghai's 'Architecture's Inscriptions', without giving dates, so it is not listed as current or upcoming.

detail.zh: 艺术家依据西岸2026主办方画廊名单与东画廊展位名单入选，候选与理由见 selection-notes.md。所有事实均来自2026年10月31日实际访问的页面；搜索摘要只用于发现线索。
detail.en: The artist was selected via the organizer's West Bund 2026 gallery list and Don Gallery's booth list; candidates and reasons are in selection-notes.md. All facts come from pages actually fetched on 31 October 2026; search snippets were used only for discovery.
